What is the product of two consecutive odd numbers, if the difference of whose square is 112?
questions.solution_en:
Let the numbers be a and (a + 2).

(a + 2)2 - a2 = 112

a2 + 4 + 4a - a2 = 112

4a + 4 = 112

4a = 108

a = 27

So, (a+2) = 27 + 2 = 29

Hence, the required product = 27 * 29 = 783

questions.q_en: A vessel contains 108 litres mixture of milk and water in a ratio 5: 7. If 10 litres of milk is added to the vessel, then how much water (in litres) should be added to the vessel to have milk and water in the ratio 11: 16?
questions.solution_en:
Initial quantity of milk = 108 * 5/(5 + 7) = 45 l

Initial quantity of water = 108 - 45 = 63 l

Let the amount of water added be 'X' l

(45 + 10)/(63 + X) = 11/16

55/(63 + X) = 11/16

80 = 63 + X

X = 17 l

questions.q_en: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 6 hours and 8 hours, respectively. Both pipes are opened together for 3 hours. After that pipe A is closed, and B continues to fill the tank. In how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.solution_en:
Efficiency of pipe A = 1/6 (tank/hour)

Efficiency of pipe B = 1/8 (tank/hour)

Part of tank filled by both pipes in 3 hours = 3 X (1/6 + 1/8)

=> [3(4+3)]/24 = 21/24 or 7/8 of the tank

Remaining part = 1 - 7/8 = 1/8 (of the tank)

Time taken by pipe B to fill the remaining tank = (1/8)/(1/8) = 1 hour

Total time taken to fill the tank = 3 + 1 = 4 hours

questions.q_en: The 5 days wage of 15 women is Rs 1875. The daily wage of a men is thrice that of women. How many men must work for 6 days to earn Rs 4500?
questions.solution_en:
1 day wage of 15 women = 1875/5 = Rs 375

1 day wage of 1 women = 375/15 = Rs 25

Wage of 1 men for 1 day is thrice of women = Rs 75

Wage of 1 men for 6 days = 75 * 6 = Rs 450

Therefore, total no. of men = total wage for 6 days/ wage of 1 men for 6 days = 4500/450 = 10

These should be placed in different trays such that each tray contains the same quantity of milk and two kinds of milk should not be mixed in a tray. What is the least number of trays required to place all the milk?
questions.solution_en:
HCF of 75, 45, 30 = 15

Trays:

Cow: 75 / 15 = 5

Toned: 45 / 15 = 3

Full cream: 30 / 15 = 2

Total = 5 + 3 + 2 = 10

Option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: The cost price and selling price of sugar are the same. Due to a faulty weighing machine, the seller earns a 25% profit. If Rs. a is the cost price of 1000 gm sugar, and the machine is changed which shows 1000 gm instead of 900 gm, what should be the selling price now to get the same percentage of profit?
questions.solution_en:
Gain% = (SP - CP)/CP * 100

Let the cost price of 1000 gram of sugar is Rs. a

Cost price of 900 gram of sugar = x/1000 * 900 = Rs. 9x/10

To earn a profit of 25% the selling price should be :

=> 9x/10 * 125/100 = 1.125x

questions.solution_en:
Let the distance between Tower and Respective points p and q when angles, 45° and 30° be 'P' m and 'Q' respectively.

tan 45° = 36√3/P

1 = 36√3 /P

P = 36√3 m

tan 30° = 36√3/Q

1/√3 = 36√3/Q

Q = 108 m

Hence, distance between p and q = 36√3 + 108 = 36 (√3 + 3) m

questions.q_en: On the tag price, a seller offers a 15% discount and a cashback of ₹450. He still earns 10% profit. If the cost price is Rs. 1800, then the tag price (rounded off to 2 decimal places) is:
questions.solution_en:
S.P = C.P * 110/100 = 1800 * 110/100 = Rs. 1980

Discount Price = Tag Price * (100 - 15)/100 = 85 * Tag Price/100

S.P = Discount Price - Cashback

1980 = 85 * Tag Price/100 - 450

Tag Price = Rs. 2858.82

questions.q_en: What is the maximum total surface area of a cuboid whose sum of length, breadth and height is 17 cm? (All the dimensions of the cuboid are integral dimensions)
questions.solution_en:
If length, breadth and height of the cuboid are; l, b and h respectively then; l + b + h = 17

Now in order to maximize total surface area we have to take the values of l, b and h close to each other.

Hence (l, b, h) = (6, 6, 5)

Therefore, total surface area of the cuboid = 2(6 X 6 + 6 X 5 + 5 X 6) = 2(36 + 30 + 30) cm2

= 192 cm2

questions.q_en: A building has a height of 213 m. If it has an angle of depression for two points on the ground on opposite sides 30° and 60° respectively, then find the distance between the two points.
questions.solution_en:
BD = distance between the 1st point and the building

CD = Distance between the 2nd point and the building

AD = height of the building

tan 30° = AD/BD

1/√3 = 213/BD

BD = 213√3 m

tan 60° = AD/DC

√3 = 213/DC

DC = 71√3 m

Hence, BD + CD = 213√3 + 71√3 = 284√3 m

questions.q_en: Two pipes P and Q together can fill a tank in 6 hours. If pipe P opened for first 4 hours, then the remaining part of the tank is filled by pipe Q alone in 9 hours. In how many hours Q can fill the tank alone?
questions.solution_en:
Let the efficiency of pipes P and Q be p and q respectively

(p + q) * 6 = 4p + 9q

6p + 6q = 4p + 9q

2p = 3q

p/q = 3/2

Total capacity of the tank = (3 + 2) * 6 = 30 units

Hence, Q will take = 30/2 = 15 hours to fill the tank.
